style: Art-rock post-punk with Persian santur, cimbalom, circuit-bent toy electronics, mridangam, pandeiro, cuíca, ngoni, and kora. Quartal suspended chord fields with bitonal friction and no tonic resolution. 3:2 asymmetric polyrhythm over a motorik pulse, finger-snap lattice, and chest percussion. Angular consonant-heavy patter bursts, register-segregated ensemble dialogue, and communal infection. Dry close separation, extreme-latency radio compression, multigeneration copy loss, digital disc skips, analog warmth through failing vacuum tubes, distorted transient peaks driving speaker cone excursion limits, continuous low-frequency hums, phase cancellation artifacts, granular time-stretching anomalies, tape flutter, wow, and harmonic distortion matrices simulating a disintegrating broadcast channel drifting through solar interference.

caption: An abrasive art-rock and world-instrument fusion exploring temporal drag, lexical inefficiency, and the messy inevitability of getting stuck inside The Stuff. Built on a 3:2 polyrhythmic substrate with hammered santur, cimbalom, and circuit-bent glitches. Vocals use obsessive consonant trills, glottal gates, and register segregation under extreme transmission latency, examining why time feels stupid and why entropy should ultimately vacate the premises immediately without debate or hesitation.
